idea-plugin.name: Glut
idea-plugin.description:
Glut beside your JetBrains IDE. Glut — a terminal coding agent with its own sandbox, gate and sessions — runs in the IDE's terminal (or in any terminal in the project's folder), and this plugin tells it what you work on:

  • the file, the cursor and the selection, with each of your messages;
  • your documents as the IDE holds them, unsaved changes too;
  • Glut's questions about edits as the IDE's own diffs, whose right side you may change before you accept;
  • what is open and what the inspections find, for Glut's model to ask.

It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, behind a fresh random token in ~/.glut/ide/<port>.json, readable by you alone.
